name: ULR Contract Examples
summary: Optional independent consumers of the Ultimate Light Rail station API.
description: Independent API v1 examples for Ultimate Light Rail 1.0.0 (revision 49). Adds a fixed 80m surface station using asset roles and a configurable component-kit station with 20m platform/roof models, through/terminus types, all supported lengths and Covered/Minimal appearances. Both use the shared Light Rail menu helper. This optional mod depends on Ultimate Light Rail; it is not required by the core. Updates and extensions within the documented public API v1 contract remain backward compatible. Breaking changes will use a new API version alongside v1; existing conforming v1 add-ons will remain supported. Included stations are available from 1925, matching the modern native tram track.
